items.statement: No irreducibility claim for the full marked Hénon incidence.
No irreducibility claim for any or every specialized fixed-b fiber.
No local-coordinate claim for every nonzero b.
No conclusion at any prescribed nonzero fiber, including b=-1.
No global injectivity, birationality, or reconstruction claim on the monic-centered normal-form cover.
No claim that every irreducible component of a general fixed-b fiber dominates or is generically étale.
No reducedness or smoothness claim for either critical/Fitting scheme.
No transversality or normal-crossings claim for the boundary intersection.
No global, nonsimple, or compactified Fitting-scheme equality beyond the simple scalar locus.
No closed-point numerical intersection multiplicity without a separately justified proper transverse slice; the theorem preserves generic multiplicities along boundary components.
No individual eigenvalue branch is a coordinate: det(DH_{b,p}^{n_i})=(-b)^{n_i}, so trace records only the unordered eigenvalue pair once the determinant is known.
No interpretation of finite-free rank d^n as an exact-cycle count.
The fiber b=0 is only the polynomial/proof boundary; H_{0,p} is not a Hénon automorphism.
No positive-characteristic extension.
No extension to multi-factor or composed generalized Hénon maps.
Point-marked fibers contain cyclic-shift copies; passage to cycle markings removes only those shifts, not residual mu_{d-1} ambiguity.
No naive coarse mu_{d-1}-quotient completed-local claim near stabilizers; stack or quotient-singularity analysis is required.
No claim that the simple exact open is finite or proper over all of B_d, no uniform all-fiber degree, and no all-fiber reconstruction.
No absolute-priority or first-ever claim.
No computational, CAS, numerical, empirical, or experimental evidence or result.

theorem_parts.statement: The simple scalar cycle-marked locus S_n is nonempty and irreducible, lies in a unique irreducible component C_n, C_n->B_d is étale and dominant, and (C_n)_{b=0}=S_n scheme-theoretically inside the simple exact disjoint incidence.
Psi=(-b,rho_1,...,rho_r) is étale at a scalar point, dominant, and generically étale; the rho_i are algebraically independent over C(b).

There is an unspecified nonempty open U in G_m such that every whole fixed-b fiber map is dominant; at least one irreducible component of the reduced fiber is dominant and generically étale. No fiber irreducibility, all-component, every-b, or prescribed-b claim.
At every simple scalar point the completed local rings are C[[b,u_0,...,u_{d-2}]] and C[[u_0,...,u_{d-2}]], with rho_i=lambda_i+bG_i uniquely.

On the simple scalar locus, Fitt_0 Omega_{C_n/T} base-changes exactly to Fitt_0 Omega_{S_n/A^r}, and J_H mod b=±J_poly. Both determinant sections are nonzero; zero schemes are effective Cartier or empty; empty multiplicity is vacuous; actual boundary components retain generic multiplicity, with no arbitrary closed-point number for d>2 without a proper transverse slice.
